name: DeepSeek LeetCode
intro: DeepSeek LeetCode 是 DeepSeek-Coder 报告中的近期竞赛评测协议：收集 180 道 Python 题，每题公开发布 100 个断言测试，并以一次生成的可执行 Pass@1 衡量正确性。
build_method: 近期竞赛题收集, 每题 100 个公开断言测试, Python 模板化
metric: Pass@1（题目通过指示器均值；总体与按难度）
task_type: 代码生成, 竞赛编程
eval_feature: 公开测试可执行判定, 直接/思维链双模式, 简单/中等/困难分层, 数据污染风险说明
scale: 180 题：简单 45、中等 91、困难 44；每题 100 个测试
build_method_en: Recent-contest Collection, 100 Public Assert Tests per Problem, Python Templating
eval_feature_en: Public-test Execution, Direct/CoT Modes, Easy/Medium/Hard Strata, Contamination Caveat
intro_en: DeepSeek LeetCode is the recent-contest protocol reported with DeepSeek-Coder: 180 Python problems with 100 public assert tests each, evaluated from one executable completion per problem using Pass@1.
scale_en: 180 problems: 45 Easy, 91 Medium, 44 Hard; 100 tests each
metric_en: Pass@1 (Mean Problem-pass Indicator; Overall and by Difficulty)

drawio_review_note: DeepSeek LeetCode has no standalone benchmark paper; it is the LeetCode Contest Benchmark in arXiv:2401.14196v2 §4.1 and Table 5, not §4.2. This review pins DeepSeek-Coder commit 2f9fd85927c669dae3c0fbb2d607274023af243e and Evaluation/LeetCode/data/20240121-Jul.jsonl blob b96d75740ab2b9c681a34b0fb39595e6710104ec. The released public tests contain 180 records (45 Easy, 91 Medium, 44 Hard), each with 100 assert cases and no disclosed train/validation split. The official prompt combines the problem description and Python template; direct mode uses the base instruction while CoT appends a step-by-step outline request. vLLM generates one completion at temperature 0 with max_tokens 1024. Evaluation extracts the first fenced Python block or applies the documented prefix fallback, then uses the HumanEval-style harness with a 10-second timeout; all 100 tests must pass. Pass@1 is the mean problem-pass indicator overall and by difficulty. The diagram keeps the paper's contamination caveat and the official harness warning that execution is not a robust security sandbox.
